facts: Mona lies eleven kilometres north of Hobart; the official visitor page gives approximately thirty minutes one way by ferry from Brooke Street Pier. Location: Getting here and Ferry.
The museum recommends booking ahead because timed entry slots are limited. Its visitor guide is called The O; some artworks may be confronting or unsuitable for children. Location: FAQs and The O.

The visitor page lists museum entry and ferry as separate ticket-required experiences. It describes subterranean floors, lifts, some inaccessible artworks, and dark or noisy areas. Location: Getting around, Good to know and booking cards.
